facts.fact: The government states that from 20 August 2025 the declaration and registration of a birth are done on site in about ten public health facilities, the parents receiving the child's NPI by SMS, with registration and the NPI free.

The government states that the one-stop desk's pilot phase was launched on 20 August 2025 at CHU-MEL Cotonou and runs for six months, August 2025 to February 2026, in ten public health facilities, with generalisation promised by ANIP afterwards.
The pilot was launched by ANIP, represented by its head of policy, partnerships and communication, with the Director of Civil Status present, on 20 August 2025.
The government states that ANIP set up the one-stop desk with the support of its partners WURI and UNICEF; no domestic budget line is stated.
